changelog:
clawbba-api 2.0.33

- Improved troubleshooting guidance for handling cases where you are billed but do not receive image/video output, with clear instructions for recovery instead of regenerating.
- Clarified expected agent behavior for incomplete media delivery: now emphasizes use of task recovery and prohibits unnecessary regeneration.
- Added detailed step to redeliver local files if not visible to the user, instead of triggering recovery or regeneration.
- Reference documentation updated: README.md and skill-card.md removed; core guidance consolidated in agent behavior and troubleshooting docs.
summary: ClawBBA × OpenClaw — One API key, 369+ models, supporting all instant messaging channels (web chat, WeChat, Telegram).
